title: I Played With Myself (in chess)
summary: 'I played with myself' = chess.com Solo Chess puzzles (only white pieces, capture your own pieces until one remains).
rules: Solo Chess puzzle (chess.com): only your own (white) pieces are on the board, no opponent.
Every move must be a capture of one of your own pieces; normal movement patterns.
Each piece may move (capture) at most twice; after its second capture it turns dark and can't move again.
If a king is on the board it must be the last piece standing (it cannot be captured).
Puzzle is complete when exactly one piece remains.
Levels 1-10 of increasing clutter; speedrun = solve the level sequence as fast as possible (timer starts on first click, stops when the check mark appears).
